select * from ( select vfp.finprod_id as finprodId, vfp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, vfp.finprod_market_id as finprodMarketId, type.type_1 as fundType, vfp.profit_type as profitType, vfp.ISSUER as issuer, vfp.ccy as ccy, vfp.idate as idate, vfp.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, msi.CALENDAR_NAME calendarName, vfp.bln_area as blnArea, vfp.trade_market as tradeMarket, vfp.ISSUER as custodian, ext.pur_speed as purSpeed, ext.red_speed as redSpeed, vfp.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, rule.pay_cycle as payCycle, rule.EFF_DATE as sdate,
rule.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, rule.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, rule.CALC_RULE as calcRule, ext.IS_COMPOUND_INT as isCompoundInt from FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE type on vfp.finprod_id = type.finprod_id left join fin_CASH_PAY_RULE rule on vfp.finprod_id = rule.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext on vfp.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO msi on vfp.CALENDAR_ID = msi.CALENDAR_ID where vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY rule.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE LIMIT=1
